ancestors: DIVISION A—KEEPING WORKERS PAID AND EMPLOYED, HEALTH CARE SYSTEM ENHANCEMENTS, AND ECONOMIC STABILIZATION
TITLE I—KEEPING AMERICAN WORKERS PAID AND EMPLOYED ACT
entries.text:
SEC. 1101. DEFINITIONS.

    In this title--
            (1) the terms ``Administration'' and ``Administrator'' mean 
        the Small Business Administration and the Administrator thereof, 
        respectively; and
            (2) the term ``small business concern'' has the meaning 
        given the term in section 3 of the Small Business Act (15 U.S.C. 
        636).
